verdict.rationale: SigNoz has a public pricing page that advertises unlimited teammates and any number of hosts (no per-seat or per-host charges). The llms.txt probe describes SigNoz Cloud as 'simple usage-based', which suggests self-serve, usage-driven pricing. The pack never shows the actual per-signal rates (per GB of logs or traces, per million metric samples), so an SRE cannot predict costs from this evidence alone. Missing for 10: published per-signal unit prices for logs, traces and metrics, a cost calculator or worked examples, explicit confirmation that no sales contact is needed, and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
